text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (sev=high) for service="inference-serving-us-west2" — symptom: node node-usw2-gpu-12 NotReady, kubelet reporting OOM/eviction errors. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/node-kubelet-notready. Paging oncall-team.

jamie: ack — I'm on call. grabbing node details now.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page acknowledged by jamie. Escalation timer reset.

jamie: quick output from `kubectl get nodes node-usw2-gpu-12 -o wide` shows NotReady, `kubectl describe node` shows repeated: "kubelet: eviction threshold reached, memory available < 0" and kubelet log shows repeated OOM kills for container runtime. GPU memory also maxed.

sasha: I can take kernel / driver side if needed. suggest cordon + drain to move user pods off this node, then reboot.

jamie: cordoning now — `kubectl cordon node-usw2-gpu-12`
jamie: draining gracefully (ignore daemonsets, delete emptydir):
```
kubectl drain node-usw2-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30
```

incident-bot: Escalation: 10m since page -> notified senior-oncall @miguel.

miguel: on it. checking metrics in grafana: node mem% and GPU mem% spiked ~1:13 UTC, GPU mem at 100% for pod `inference-batch-7`. Looks like batch job leaked GPU allocation.

sasha: if the batch pod won't reschedule because of huge requests, we should scale down the batch workers and let the scheduler rebalance. I'll prepare a temporary scale patch.

jamie: scaling batch workers down: `kubectl scale deploy inference-batch --replicas=0 -n ml-jobs` — evicting problematic pod.

jamie: customer impact summary: embeddings/batch endpoints in us-west-2 saw ~18-25% error rate and 4-6x latency spikes for ~9 minutes while node was NotReady. No data loss, transient failures only. Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/USW2-2026-03-12 (notify cs). cc @customer-success

lisa: good handoff note — I'm scheduled to take over in 30m. please leave a short runbook summary in the thread for next shift.

jamie: rebooting node now (sudo systemctl reboot) after drain completed.

deploy-bot: Action: restart-kubelet triggered on node-usw2-gpu-12 by jamie.

jamie: node came back to Ready at ~1763004560. running smoke checks: small inference requests ok, batch queue rescheduling now.

miguel: double-checking logs — driver load looks fine after reboot. root cause candidate: unbounded GPU allocation in inference-batch job (no resource limits). Created follow-up INF-3411: add GPU memory requests/limits + OOM alert.

jamie: uncordoning node: `kubectl uncordon node-usw2-gpu-12`. letting scheduler rebalance. monitoring.

sasha: confirmed pods moving back, GPU utilization returning to normal. I'll keep an eye for any kernel oops.

jamie: summary for handoff -> timeline + mitigation: page fired at 1763004321, ack & cordon/drain, scaled batch to 0, rebooted node, uncordoned at 1763004568, node healthy. Impact: transient errors for embeddings/batch in us-west-2. Follow-ups: INF-3411 (add GPU limits, add GPU OOM alert), update runbook to include `kubectl drain` pattern for GPU nodes, consider automatic eviction for oversized batch jobs.

lisa: taking over. I'll close the page after monitoring window (15m) if no regressions. leave this thread pinned for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved by jamie.

jamie: marking incident resolved for oncall, leaving notes in INF-3411 and will file short postmortem template in #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
